summary_en: 2.75M shares (3.86% S/O) ¥5,915M upper limit. Price ¥2,151/share (10.0% discount to Aug 6 close of ¥2,390). Execution Aug 10 - Sep 7, 2026 (20 business days). ToSTNeT-3. Rationale: mitigate market impact from large-block shareholder sale; execute capital return per medium-term plan; improve ROE and EPS.
title_en: Supplementary Explanatory Material on Treasury Stock Acquisition and Public Offer to Purchase Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: AS ONE CORPORATION filed a public offer to purchase its own treasury stock on 7 August 2026. The company will acquire up to 2.75 million shares (3.86% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥5,915 million at a fixed price of ¥2,151 per share. This price represents a 10.0% discount to the closing price of ¥2,390 on 6 August 2026 (the business day before board approval). The tender offer window runs from 10 August to 7 September 2026 (20 business days), with settlement commencing on 6 October 2026. Execution method is ToSTNeT-3 (off-board trading). The rationale stated in the disclosure is threefold: to cushion the market impact of a large block sale by a major shareholder; to achieve cash-out savings by acquiring shares at a discounted price; and to implement shareholder returns aligned with the medium-term management plan while improving return on equity (ROE) and earnings per share (EPS).
